# Results (generated by `scripts/make_results.py` — do not edit by hand)

All numbers are on data never used for fitting or tuning: the **official C-MAPSS test set** (RUL at the last observed cycle) and **held-out run-to-failure engines** (15% of the training engines, split by engine). Mean ± std over seeds (each seed changes the engine split and model initialisation).

Engines: fit 70, calibration 15, holdout 15, official test 100.
